segment.source: In this mission you will learn to adjust your power configuration system, target the enemy and destroy unarmed Imperial TIE Fighters and stationary Cargo ships.
segment.target: 在此任務中，你將學習 調整動力分配系統、 鎖定敵機，並摧毀 未裝備武裝的帝國鈦戰機 與靜止的貨船。

segment.source: Using the same holographic technology as in the [[Pilot's]] [[Proving Ground Courses]], the [[Historical Combat Simulations]] were designed to quickly and efficiently train new starfighter pilot recruits in actual combat tactics. They are also used by experienced pilots to hone their skills and develop new tactics. One incredible story is of what happened to a young recruit named [[Dev ]]during his first run through the[[ "Maze"]].
segment.target: 運用與[[飛行員]][[試驗場課程]]相同的全像技術，[[歷史戰鬥模擬]]旨在迅速且高效地培訓星際戰機新進飛行員的實戰戰術。資深飛行員亦藉此磨練技巧並研發新戰術。一段令人難以置信的傳奇故事，便是年輕新兵[[戴夫]]在初次挑戰[[「迷宮」]]時的經歷。

segment.source: Though it was Dev's first time on the course, he impressively cleared the first six gates with ease. But then something unexpected happened. As Dev banked his X-wing towards the next platform, he accidently jumped into hyperspace, emerging in the middle of an [[Imperial Training Ground]]! Thinking it was part of the course, Dev started firing at the stationary Imperial starfighters.
segment.target: 儘管這是戴夫第一次飛這條路線，他卻以令人驚艷的俐落身手輕鬆通過前六道關卡。但隨後發生了意料之外的事。當戴夫側傾他的 X翼戰機轉向下一個平臺時，他意外跳入了超空間，並出現在一個[[帝國訓練場]]正中央！戴夫以為這也是訓練課程的一部分，便開始向停泊靜止的帝國星際戰機開火。

segment.source: Concentrating completely on destroying the Empire's hardware, it was some time before he noticed the message from his [[R2 unit]] indicating that he was in [[Imperial territory]] and should immediately hyperspace back to the Rebel Proving Ground. Shocked and somewhat shaken, Dev managed to return safely home.$ Your mission is to destroy all of the Imperial craft in the area within [[15 minutes]].
segment.target: 他全神貫注於摧毀帝國裝備，過了好一陣子才注意到[[R2 機器人]]傳來的警告訊息，指出他身處[[帝國領空]]，應立即超空間跳躍返回反抗軍試驗場。戴夫震驚且餘悸猶存，最終成功平安返航。$你的任務是在[[15 分鐘]]內摧毀該區域內的所有帝國機艦。

segment.source: recruits a taste of engaging Imperial fighter craft.$$Your mission is to destroy all Imperial starfighters within the given time limit.
segment.target: 讓新兵體驗與帝國戰機交戰的滋味。$$你的任務是在指定時限內摧毀所有帝國星際戰機。

segment.source: [[Red One]] will drop into an Imperial Training Area in the [[Senex System]].
segment.target: [[紅一號]]將進入位於[[塞尼克斯星系]]的帝國訓練區。

segment.source: Use your forward and rear [[Sensors]] to quickly locate your enemy.
segment.target: 運用你的前向與後向[[感測器]]迅速標定敵機位置。

segment.source: Use your [[Combat MultiView Display]] and [[Targeting System]] to track the enemy.
segment.target: 運用你的[[戰鬥多功能視圖顯示器]]與[[目標鎖定系統]]追蹤敵機。

segment.source: Vary your [[speed]] and configure your [[power system]] for highest impact.
segment.target: 靈活調節你的[[飛行速度]]並調整[[動力系統]]配置以達到最大作戰效能。

segment.source: A variety of Imperial craft are in the area. Target the [[fighters]] first.
segment.target: 該區域內有各式帝國機艦。請優先鎖定[[戰機]]。

segment.source: You have successfully destroyed all enemy targets!
segment.target: 你已成功摧毀所有敵方目標！

segment.source: Keep it up and continue with the next mission!
segment.target: 表現出色，請繼續進行下一個任務！

segment.source: In this mission you will engage Imperial forces for the first time. You will learn the value of a wingman and the importance of working as a fighter team.
segment.target: 在此任務中，你將首次 與帝國部隊正式交戰。 你將體會僚機的價值， 以及身為戰機編隊成員 協同作戰的重要性。

segment.source: Stay close! You're responsible for his safety while he makes his attack.
segment.target: 保持貼近！在他展開攻擊時，你必須負責掩護他的安全。

segment.source: Watch and learn as [[Red Leader ]]takes out TIE Fighters on point defense.
segment.target: 仔細觀察並學習[[紅色長官]]如何摧毀執行定點防禦的鈦戰機。

segment.source: No one starts as[[ ]]a[[ Flight Leader]]. It takes dedication, practice and patience to become a great starfighter pilot. Put in your time, study hard and practice as much as you can. Soon, you will earn your place as a combat leader.$This mission pits you and your flight leader against a group of TIE fighters. As a [[wingman]], protect your flight leader's back, stay close and learn from his experience.
segment.target: 沒有人一開始就是[[分隊長]]。要成為一名頂尖的星際戰機飛行員，需要奉獻、苦練與耐心。投入時間、刻苦鑽研並全力練習。不久之後，你也能憑實力贏得作戰分隊長的席位。$此任務中，你將與你的分隊長聯手迎戰一群鈦戰機。作為一名[[僚機]]，請掩護分隊長的後方，保持貼近並向他的經驗學習。

segment.source: Learning to function as a member of a team is the most important thing you can do to strengthen the [[Rebellion]]. All our strategy and tactics are founded on [[teamwork]]. It is this principle that allows the precision timing needed to conduct operations against a superior force. $ As you grow more confident you may wish to take the lead position and experiment with the [[wingman commands]].
segment.target: 學會成為團隊的一份子，是壯大[[反抗軍同盟]]最重要的一環。我們所有的戰略與戰術皆奠基於[[團隊合作]]。正是這項原則，使我們能在面對強敵時以精準的時機協同作戰。$隨著你信心日增，你也可以嘗試擔任領航位置，並練習使用[[僚機指令]]。
所有敵方戰機已遭殲滅

segment.source: This mission teaches you to use your laser guns with precision by targeting and destroying small objects, such as satellites and mines.
segment.target: 本任務將訓練你 精準使用雷射砲， 鎖定並摧毀小型目標， 例如衛星與太空雷。

segment.source: Imperial Forces are setting up new Surveillance satellites near [[Coruscant]].
segment.target: 帝國軍正在[[科羅森]]附近部署全新偵察衛星。

segment.source: They are surrounded and protected by Imperial Heat-Tracking Laser Mines.$
segment.target: 它們被帝國熱追蹤雷射太空雷重重包圍並受到保護。$

segment.source: Eliminate the Transports and all Mines, then quickly destroy the Satellites.
segment.target: 殲滅運輸船與所有太空雷，隨後迅速摧毀衛星。

segment.source: You only have a few minutes before an Imperial Frigate responds.
segment.target: 在帝國巡防艦前來馳援之前，你只有幾分鐘的時間。

segment.source: The Empire has placed thousands of [[surveillance satellites]] throughout the Galaxy. Each of them is linked to the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] in the Imperial City. This vast network gives the Emperor's Security Forces the ability to monitor (and control) the [[Core Worlds]] and the Primary Territories of the Republic. This network is now being expanded into the [[Outer Rim Territories]].
segment.target: 帝國在全銀河系布署了數千顆[[偵察衛星]]。每一顆都與帝國首都的[[帝國安全局]]相互連線。這個龐大的網路賦予帝皇的安全部隊監控（與控制）[[核心世界]]以及前共和國主領域的能力。如今該網路正進一步擴展至[[外環星域]]。

segment.source: The satellites are often hidden in asteroid fields or near uninhabited planets and protected by complex arrays of [[mines]]. Destruction of these satellites is extremely disruptive to Imperial control and is therefore aggressively pursued.$ In this mission your goal is to destroy all Imperial [[Transports]], [[Mines]] and[[ Satellites]]. Keep your shield strength up and bear in mind that a single laser blast will blow up a mine.$
segment.target: 衛星通常隱匿於小行星帶中或鄰近無人居住的星球，並由密集的[[太空雷]]陣列護衛。摧毀這些衛星對破壞帝國的控制具有極大戰略價值，因此我們全力打擊。$在此任務中，你的目標是摧毀所有帝國[[運輸船]]、[[太空雷]]與[[衛星]]。請保持護盾強度，並記住只需一發雷射射擊便能引爆太空雷。$

segment.source: The Surveillance satellites have been destroyed
Rebel starfighter pilots almost always fight outnumbered by the Empire by at least three to one. This mission will teach you to beat these odds.
segment.target: 反抗軍星際戰機飛行員 作戰時幾乎總是處於劣勢， 敵機數量至少是我們的 三倍以上。本任務將 訓練你如何克服逆境、 以寡敵眾。

segment.source: X-wings from [[Red Squadron]] will test Imperial defenses near [[Circarpous IV]].
segment.target: 來自[[紅色中隊]]的 X翼戰機將試探[[賽卡波斯四號星]]附近的帝國防禦體系。

segment.source: You may expect to encounter [[TIE Fighters]] performing barrier defense.
segment.target: 預期你將遭遇執行屏障防禦的[[鈦戰機]]。

segment.source: An X-wing starfighter and a highly trained pilot make a deadly combination. Using a variation of the venerable [[hit and fade]] tactic, Rebel pilots are often able to lure superior numbers of enemy fighters to their doom.$ Imperial Rules of Combat Engagement demand a [[three to one]] ratio in their favor before attacking. Your training will prepare you to overcome these odds, however!
segment.target: 一架 X翼星際戰機配合訓練有素的飛行員是致命的組合。透過經典[[突襲消逝]]戰術的靈活變奏，反抗軍飛行員往往能將優勢數量的敵機誘入絕境。$帝國交戰準則要求在攻擊前必須具備[[三對一]]的數量優勢。然而，你的嚴格訓練將使你足以克敵制勝、反敗為勝！

segment.source: [[Engage]] and [[destroy]] the TIEs and then return to base.
segment.target: [[交戰]]並[[摧毀]]鈦戰機，隨後返回基地。

segment.source: This mission recreates a feint into the Circarpous System to gauge Imperial defenses there. Taking the bait, a group of TIE fighters tangled with the three X-wings from [[Red Squadron]].[[ ]] They should have stayed at their base. All the TIE's were destroyed with no Rebel losses! Needless to say this left quite an impression on the people of the [[Circarpous System]]. Move quickly to engage and get your share of kills.
segment.target: 本任務重現了一次佯攻賽卡波斯星系以試探當地帝國防禦的行動。敵方中計後，一群鈦戰機與來自[[紅色中隊]]的三架 X翼戰機展開纏鬥。[[ ]]他們真該老實待在基地的。所有鈦戰機全遭殲滅，而反抗軍毫髮無傷！毋庸置疑，這給[[賽卡波斯星系]]的居民留下了深刻印象。迅速投入戰鬥，奪取屬於你的戰果吧。
你成功克服劣勢、克敵制勝

segment.source: This mission recreates one of the most spectacular life or death rescue missions in history. Especially from the view of a particularly daring X-wing pilot: Halley Kadorto.
segment.target: 本任務重現了歷史上 最驚心動魄的生死救援 任務之一。特別是從一位 無比英勇的 X翼戰機飛行員 哈利·卡多托的視角出發。

segment.source: Freighters bearing [[war materiel]] and [[slaves]] await a Star Destroyer.
segment.target: 載運[[軍用物資]]與[[奴隸]]的貨船正在等待滅星者抵達。

segment.source: [[Alliance Freighters]] will arrive when the Calamarians have been located.
segment.target: 一旦確認蒙卡拉馬里人的位置，[[同盟貨船]]便會抵達。

segment.source: Beware, the [[Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Warrior]] could arrive at any moment!
segment.target: 當心，[[帝國滅星者]][[戰士號]]隨時可能出現！

segment.source: This mission recreates an incredible rescue operation with you in the role of one of our most daring X-wing pilots, [[Halley Kadorto]].$ Rebel Intelligence had gathered information of a secret rendezvous location where the Empire would be transferring Mon Calamari slaves and various war materiel to an arriving Star Destroyer. A combined force of X-wings, Y-wings and Freighters was assembled for the mission.
segment.target: 本任務重現了一次不可思議的救援作戰，你將扮演我們最無畏的 X翼戰機飛行員之一[[哈利·卡多托]]。$反抗軍情報部門獲悉了一處祕密會合地點，帝國將在那裡把蒙卡拉馬里奴隸與各式軍用物資轉移至即將抵達的滅星者。一支由 X翼戰機、Y翼戰機與貨船組成的聯合部隊已集結完畢，準備展開行動。

segment.source: [[Red Squadron's]] X-wings would first engage the TIE Fighter escorts, as [[Gold Squadron's]] Y-wings hypered in behind them to disable the Freighters. Halley identified which craft were carrying slaves and the Rebel Freighters were brought in to receive the liberated Calamarians. The entire operation was planned to be safely concluded before the [[Star Destroyer Warrior]] could arrive.
segment.target: [[紅色中隊]]的 X翼戰機將首先迎戰護航的鈦戰機，隨後[[金色中隊]]的 Y翼戰機跳躍進場癱瘓貨船。哈利負責辨識載有奴隸的船艦，並引導反抗軍貨船進場接收獲釋的蒙卡拉馬里人。整場作戰原本計畫在[[滅星者戰士號]]抵達前安全結束。

segment.source: Unfortunately the [[Warrior]] arrived early and immediately launched an attack of its own. It was soon realized that the Imperials were attacking their own slave ships! Typical for the Empire, they would rather massacre thousands of innocent beings than let them fall into the hands of the enemy!$ One pilot, [[Halley Kadorto, ]]thwarted the ruthless assault by taking on wave after wave of TIE fighters.
segment.target: 不幸的是，[[戰士號]]提前抵達並立即發動攻勢。我們很快發現帝國竟然在向自己的奴隸船開火！這正是帝國的典型作風——寧可殘殺數千名無辜生靈，也不願讓他們落入敵人手中！$而飛行員[[哈利·卡多托]]挺身對抗一波波來襲的鈦戰機，力挽狂瀾化解了這場殘酷的屠殺。

segment.source: A number of [[TIE Fighters]] are watching over the transfer of cargo.
segment.target: 多架[[鈦戰機]]正在看守貨物轉移作業。

segment.source: X-wings from [[Red Squadron]] will drop in here and engage the TIE Fighters.
segment.target: 來自[[紅色中隊]]的 X翼戰機將在此處跳入戰場並迎擊鈦戰機。

segment.source: [[Destroy]] all war materiel containers and freighters before leaving.
segment.target: 撤離前必須[[摧毀]]所有軍用物資貨櫃與貨船。

segment.source: Y-wings from [[Gold Squadron]] will follow shortly to disable the freighters.
segment.target: 來自[[金色中隊]]的 Y翼戰機隨後便會跟進，負責癱瘓貨船。

segment.source: For bravely saving so many lives Halley Kadorto received the [[Kalidor Crescent]]! Can you do as well?$ Eliminate the escorts first and try to locate the [[Calamarians]] as quickly as possible. You will have to fly your X-wing within [[0.02]] kilometers of each ship whose contents you want to identify. Protect the Freighters while the transfer takes place then destroy the remaining Imperial war materiel before leaving.
segment.target: 因英勇拯救如此多無辜生命，哈利·卡多托獲頒了[[卡利多新月勳章]]！你能否表現得一樣出色？$請優先殲滅護航敵機，並盡速找出[[蒙卡拉馬里人]]的所在位置。你必須駕駛 X翼戰機接近至各船艦[[0.02]]公里以內，方能辨識其貨物內容。在轉移過程中保護貨船安全，並在離開前摧毀剩餘的帝國軍用物資。

segment.source: Hooray! All Calamari prisoners have been rescued!
segment.target: 太棒了！所有蒙卡拉馬里俘虜均已獲救！

segment.source: Back to mothership and lets celebrate!
segment.target: 返回母艦好好慶祝一番吧！

segment.source: This mission will teach you the importance of teamwork in a complicated operation to capture secret Imperial documents.
segment.target: 本任務將教導你 在奪取帝國機密文件 的複雜作戰行動中， 團隊合作的重要性。

segment.source: An Imperial Corvette will be stopping near [[Turkana]] in the [[Hadar]] sector.
segment.target: 一艘帝國巡邏艦將在[[哈達爾]]星區的[[圖爾卡納]]附近停泊。

segment.source: The Alliance Frigate [[Liberator]] will pop up here to draw off its escorts.
segment.target: 同盟巡防艦[[解放者號]]將在此處現身，引開其護航機艦。

segment.source: [[Blue Squadron]] will drop in behind the TIEs to make a surprise flank attack.
segment.target: [[藍色中隊]]將跳躍至鈦戰機後方，發動側翼突襲。

segment.source: This mission recreates the famous first mission of [[Keyan Farlander]]. Though still in training, his natural skill earned him an invitation to volunteer for what turned out to be a very vital mission.$ In the event, he proved himself quite capable in combat. In addition, he was personally responsible for recovering some extremely valuable Imperial documents.
segment.target: 本任務重現了[[基揚·法蘭德]]著名的首次出擊。儘管當時他仍在受訓階段，但他過人的天賦使他獲邀自願參與這項至關重要的關鍵任務。$在行動中，他證明了自己卓越的作戰能力。此外，他還親手奪回了極具價值的帝國機密文件。

segment.source: Alliance Intelligence had discovered elaborate precautions being taken to make a particular Imperial Corvette seem unimportant. At the risk of blowing their cover our agents determined that the ship would have extremely important contents, possibly [[Darth Vader]] himself! Furthermore, it would have a skeleton crew and minimal escort. It was scheduled to make one stop near lightly defended [[Turkana ]]in the[[ Hadar Sector]].
segment.target: 同盟情報部門發現帝國正採取周密的掩護措施，試圖讓一艘特定的帝國巡邏艦顯得微不足道。我們的特工冒著身分暴露的危險，查明該艦載有極為重要的機密，甚至可能是[[達斯·維達]]本人！此外，該艦僅配備基本船員與最少量的護航部隊。它預定在防衛薄弱的[[哈達爾星區]][[圖爾卡納]]附近作短暫停留。

segment.source: In the position of Keyan in [[Red Squadron]], you will be protecting [[Gold Squadron's]] Y-wings while they disable the [[Imperial Corvette]]. Then you will help maintain security in the area while the [[Storm Unit Commandos]] conduct their boarding raid.$ Feel free to assist the Y-wings in bringing down the Corvette's shields. If all goes well and you have time, you may join up with [[Blue Squadron ]]to mop up the remaining escorts.
segment.target: 你將扮演[[紅色中隊]]的法蘭德，負責掩護[[金色中隊]]的 Y翼戰機癱瘓該艘[[帝國巡邏艦]]。隨後，你將在[[風暴部隊突擊兵]]進行登艦強襲期間維持區域警戒安全。$請適時協助 Y翼戰機擊破巡邏艦的護盾。若一切進展順利且時間充裕，你可以加入[[藍色中隊]]合力掃蕩殘餘的護航機艦。

segment.source: Y-wings from [[Gold Squadron]] will come in and disable the Corvette.
segment.target: 來自[[金色中隊]]的 Y翼戰機將進入戰場並癱瘓該巡邏艦。

segment.source: Once disabled the [[Storm Unit's Commandos]] will conduct the boarding.
segment.target: 一旦目標癱瘓，[[風暴部隊突擊兵]]將立即展開登艦行動。

segment.source: Throughout the attack [[Red Squadron]] will protect Gold and Storm Unit.
segment.target: 在整場進攻中，[[紅色中隊]]將持續掩護金隊與風暴部隊。

segment.source: The Storm Units have confiscated all Imperial Holo discs
segment.target: 風暴部隊已成功扣押所有帝國全像光碟
這又是同盟的一大勝利
